features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.description:
A warrior is proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with all armor (light, medium, and heavy) and shields (except tower shields).
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Critical Strikes
features.description:
This Limit Break causes the warrior to focus on the weak spots and deadly parts of an enemy to deal the most damage. For a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four warrior levels after 1st, the warrior counts his first successful attack with his chosen weapon as a confirmed critical hit, every attack thereafter gains a +4 competence bonus on confirmation checks. This limit break requires only a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift).
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Omnistrike
features.description:
This Limit Break hones the warrior’s speed, increasing his number of attacks. For a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four warrior levels after 1st, during a full-attack with his chosen weapon, the warrior can make 1 additional attack at his highest BAB, another at -5 at 6th level, another at -10 at 11th level, and one last one at -15 at 16th level. These attacks are not doubled by any other effect but otherwise stack with haste and similar effects. This limit break requires only a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift).

features.name: Fighter Training
features.description:
At 1st level, a warrior counts his warrior levels as fighter levels for all feat purposes. Warrior levels acquired from any class count as fighter levels for all feat purposes.

features.name: Chosen Weapon
features.description:

The bonus improves by +1 for every four warrior levels beyond 1st. features.name: Martial Flexibility
features.description:
A warrior can take a [move action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#move) to gain the benefit of a combat feat he doesn’t possess. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The warrior must meet all the feat’s prerequisites. He may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + half his warrior level. The warrior can use this ability again before the duration expires in order to replace the previous combat feat with another choice. If a combat feat has a daily use limitation (such as Stunning Fist), any uses of that combat feat while using this ability count toward that feat’s daily limit.

At 6th level, a warrior can use this ability to gain the benefit of two combat feats at the same time. He may select one feat as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) or two feats as a [move action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#move). He may use one of these feats to meet a prerequisite of the second feat; doing so means that he cannot replace a feat currently fulfilling another’s prerequisite without also replacing those feats that require it. Each individual feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability.

At 10th level, a warrior can use this ability to gain the benefit of three combat feats at the same time. He may select one feat as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), two feats as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift), or three feats as a [move action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#move). He may use one of the feats to meet a prerequisite of the second and third feats, and use the second feat to meet a prerequisite of the third feat. Each individual feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability.

At 12th level, a warrior can use this ability to gain the benefit of one combat feat as an [immediate action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#immediate) or three combat feats as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift). Each individual feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability.

At 20th level, a warrior can use this ability to gain the benefit of any number of combat feats as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift). Each feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability.

features.name: Combat Defenses
features.description:
At 1st level, the warrior trains to avoid the folly of what he would inflict on his opponents. He adds half his warrior level (minimum 1) to his CMD versus one of the following maneuvers: [Bull Rush](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Bull-Rush), [Dirty Trick](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Dirty-Trick), [Disarm](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Disarm), [Drag](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Drag), [Grapple](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Grapple), [Overrun](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Overrun), [Reposition](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Reposition), [Steal](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Steal), [Sunder](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Sunder), [Trip](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Trip).

This choice is made at 1st level and can be changed to a different maneuver at each new warrior level.

features.name: Combat Offenses
features.description:
At 2nd level, a warrior trains to always pull off the maneuver he has in mind. He gains a bonus feat from the “improved” feats for combat maneuvers, such as [Improved Bull Rush](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-bull-rush-combat), even if he does not have the normal prerequisites for that feat.

This choice is made at 2nd level, and can be changed to a different “improved” maneuver feat at each new warrior level. This cannot be changed if it is used as a pre-requisite for another feat.

features.name: Warrior Talents
features.description:
As a warrior gains experience, he learns a number of talents that aid him and confound his foes. Starting at 2nd level, the warrior gains one warrior talent. He gains an additional warrior talent for every 2 levels of warrior attained after 2nd level. Unless specified otherwise, a warrior cannot select an individual talent more than once.

* A complete list of warrior talents can be found here: [Warrior Talents](http://finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/warrior/warrior-talents/)

features.name: Warrior Techniques
features.description:
At 3rd level the warrior gains the source Warrior Techniques. Stamina and individual techniques are separate cards for exact archetype replacement.
At 3rd level, the warrior learns the use of many varying techniques both in and out of combat that aid his ability to win almost any fight. The warrior gains a stamina pool that has a number of points equal to half his warrior level + his Constitution modifier (minimum 1). The pool refreshes once per day when the warrior rests for a full 8 hours.

features.name: Chosen Knowledge
features.description:
At 3rd level, the warrior knows his chosen weapons inside and out.

The warrior adds his level as a bonus on any Craft, Knowledge, Perform, Profession, and [Repair](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/skills/#repair) checks that deal with a weapon from his chosen weapon group.

When using [Repair](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/skills/#repair) on his chosen weapon, the warrior can mend his weapon in half the time as normal. The warrior may restore his weapon after being destroyed once, and magical enhancements on the weapon return, but will fade if it is destroyed again before receiving magical repairing such as from [Make Whole](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/m/make-whole/), at which point the warrior can repair it once more.

features.name: Physical Resilience
features.description:
At 4th level, if the warrior takes ability damage, ability drain, or a temporary penalty to an ability score, this damage, drain, or penalty is reduced by 1 point. This reduction improves by 1 at 8th level and for every four warrior levels beyond that (to a maximum reduction of 5 at 20th level).

features.name: Additional Techs II
features.description:
At 5th level, the warrior can make use of the following warrior techniques:

* **Reliable Strike ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** Once per round as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), even outside of his turn, the warrior can spend 1 stamina to immediately reroll the last attack roll he just made with a weapon from his chosen weapon group, this must be done after the roll is made but before the outcome is known.
* **Resolute Act (**[**Ex**](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)**):** As a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), the warrior can add a +2 competence bonus to a skill check by spending 1 stamina. At 9th level, and every 4 warrior levels thereafter, this competence bonus increases by +1 (to a maximum of +5 at 17th level). The warrior can use this ability after a skill check is rolled, but before the results are revealed.
* **Rush ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** The warrior can charge at an enemy as a [full-round action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#full-round) by spending 1 stamina, if his attack hits, he may make a free [Bull Rush](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Bull-Rush) attempt that adds +1 for every 5 feet he moved towards his target.

features.name: Weapon Guard
features.description:
At 5th level, a warrior adds his chosen weapon bonus on saves against any effect that target his held weapons.

features.name: Robust Physique
features.description:
At 6th level, whenever the warrior takes lethal damage, 1 point of this damage may be converted to nonlethal damage, warrior’s choice. The amount of damage that may be converted increases to 2 points of damage at 10th level, 3 points of damage at 14th level, and 4 points of damage at 18th level. This damage conversion has no effect on bleed damage or damage that is already nonlethal.

features.name: Additional Techs III
features.description:
At 7th level, the warrior can make use of the following warrior techniques:

* **Backswing ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** The warrior can initiate a backswing attack, as part of a [full-round action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#full-round), at the cost of 2 stamina. The warrior makes a full-attack with a weapon from his chosen weapon group, and adds double his Strength bonus on damage rolls for all attacks after the first with a two-handed weapon, 1 1/2 times his Strength bonus with a one-handed weapon, and full Strength bonus on all off-handed attacks. This ability doesn’t stack with any other ability that applies a different ability score (or ability score as a different type) to damage, nor abilities that alter the calculation of your Strength bonus on damage.
* **Beatdown ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** The warrior puts his full force behind a single attack, or one made within a full-attack, as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) that costs 1 stamina. If the attack hits, it deals double damage.
* **Blitz (**[**Ex**](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)**):** When the warrior hits an enemy with a melee attack, he may spend 1 stamina as a free action to perform an additional combat maneuver against the enemy struck. Blitz can only be used once per round. The warrior must have the “improved” feat for the combat maneuver he performs.

features.name: Weapon Adaption
features.description:
At 7th level, when a warrior wields a weapon he isn’t proficient with, he reduces the non-proficiency penalty by 2 (to a minimum of 0). At 15th level, he instead reduces the penalty by 4. Even if this reduces the penalty to 0, the warrior doesn’t count as being proficient with these weapons.

features.name: Secure Weaponry
features.description:
At 8th level, a warrior defensively counters when an opponent uses an effect which would harm his held weapon or cause him to drop it. If the effect is a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural ability which doesn’t grant the warrior or his weapon a saving throw, the warrior gains a Reflex save to negate the effect, calculating the DC as if the effect did allow a save. Otherwise, if the effect is an extraordinary or non-magical ability that doesn’t require the opponent to succeed at a check against the warrior’s CMD then the opponent must succeed at a combat maneuver check against the warrior as if attempting a disarm, steal, or sunder combat maneuver, as appropriate for the effect, or the effect is negated.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Additional Techs IV
features.description:
At 9th level, the warrior can make use of the following warrior techniques:

* **Endure (**[**Ex**](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)**):** As an [immediate action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#immediate) that costs 1 stamina, the warrior suppresses all effects related to dying (disabled, unconscious, dying, dead) from sustaining hit point damage until the start of his next turn. This effect is lost if the warrior amasses an amount of negative hit points equal to or more than his maximum hit point value during this period.
* **Rapid Attack ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** As a [full-round action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#full-round), a warrior can combine a full-attack with a single move at the cost of 2 stamina. He must forgo an attack at his highest bonus but may take the remaining attacks at any point during his movement. In addition, a warrior that dual-wields or uses a double weapon also must forgo the first off-hand attack he can make. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. This cannot be combined with backswing.
* **Wild Swing ([Ex](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#extraordinary)):** By spending 1 stamina as a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard), the warrior makes a single attack against each adjacent enemy.

features.name: Tenacious Grip
features.description:
At 9th level, a warrior doesn’t drop held weapons when panicked or stunned. If the warrior gains the ability to retain his weapons when panicked or stunned from another source, then he also gains the autonomic grasp class feature (see below) and gains the weapon unity class feature at 11th level (instead of 13th).

features.name: War Cry
features.description:
At 10th level, as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift), a warrior can give a war cry to his allies, inspiring them to fight better. This is a warrior technique that requires 1 stamina.

His allies (the warrior is unaffected) that can hear him gains a +2 competence bonus on attack rolls, +2 morale bonus on saving throws, and a +2 dodge bonus to AC. The effect lasts for 1 round per two warrior class levels.

features.name: Aggressor
features.description:
At 11th level, the warrior is able to leave himself open to attack to allow for a better angle at attacking his foes. As a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), the warrior may reduce his AC by an amount up to his Constitution modifier, adding this as a [circumstance](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/glossary#TOC-Circumstance-Bonus) bonus to his attack rolls. This penalty and bonus last until the beginning of his next turn.

features.name: Autonomic Grasp
features.description:
At 11th level, a warrior clings to his weaponry even when on the brink of death. A warrior can choose to retain his hold on his wielded weapons when he is knocked unconscious or succumbs to a sleep effect. While the warrior is asleep or unconscious, attackers must succeed at combat maneuver checks to disarm him, but he gains relevant bonuses for attacking a helpless target, including treating the warrior’s Dexterity as 0 when determining his CMD.

features.name: Warrior Advanced Talents
features.description:
At 12th level, and every two levels thereafter, a warrior can choose one of the following warrior advanced talents in place of a warrior talent.

* A complete list of advanced warrior talents can be found here: [Warrior Advanced Talents](http://finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/warrior/warrior-talents/#warrior-advanced-talents)

features.name: Improved Rush
features.description:
At 13th level, the warrior may use his Rush warrior technique as a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard)**.**

features.name: Weapon Unity
features.description:
At 13th level, a warrior’s preferred weapons become almost an extension of his body. A warrior is immune to steal and sunder combat maneuvers made against a weapon he is wielding, provided the warrior has Weapon Focus with the weapon or the weapon belongs to weapon group which he possesses. A helpless warrior does not gain the benefits of this ability.

features.name: Critical Aim
features.description:
At 14th level, the warrior’s aim becomes a precise deadliness. The critical threat range of all weapons from his chosen weapon group in the hands of the warrior is increased by 1. At 18th level, this increases by 1 again. This increase stacks with Improved Critical or Keen effects but applies after.

features.name: Unstoppable Strike
features.description:
At 15th level, a warrior can take a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard) to make one attack with a weapon from his chosen weapon group as a touch attack that ignores damage reduction (or hardness, if attacking an object).

features.name: Combat Composure
features.description:
At 15th level, a warrior can take 10 on skill checks during combat even if the situation or immediate danger wouldn’t normally allow him to do so, provided the skill is a class skill, he is trained in the skill, and he could take 10 on the check outside of combat. The warrior cannot use this ability if he currently has any of the following conditions: confused, cowering, dazed, disabled, exhausted, fascinated, fatigued, flat-footed, frightened, helpless, nauseated, panicked, paralyzed, shaken, sickened, staggered, or stunned.

features.name: Assured Crits
features.description:
At 16th level, a warrior gains a +4 bonus to confirm critical hits using weapons from his chosen weapon group.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Devastating Blow
features.description:
At 17th level, as a [standard action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#standard), a warrior may make a single melee attack with a weapon from his chosen weapon group at a –5 penalty. If the attack hits, it is treated as a critical hit and deals double damage.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Flawless Technique
features.description:
At 17th level, a warrior doesn’t automatically miss an attack roll when he rolls a natural 1.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Assured Strike
features.description:
At 19th level, once per round before making an attack roll as a [free action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#free), a warrior can choose to treat the d20 result as a 10.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Doublestrike
features.description:
At 19th level, once per day, a warrior can spend a [full-round action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#full-round) to make a full attack with double his normal number of attacks. He must declare his opponent beforehand and cannot switch targets while he executes his Doublestrike ability. Doublestrike doesn’t double extra attacks gain through [*haste*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/h/haste/) or any other similar effects that grants additional attacks nor does it stack with any other class feature that doubles a number of attacks. He cannot make critical hits or precision-based attacks (such as sneak attack), and Strength modifiers are halved (rounded down) during the round he uses this ability.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description:
At 20th level, the warrior has mastered his chosen weapon group. Any attacks made with his chosen weapon group automatically confirm all critical threats and have his critical hit threat range increased by 2. This stacks with Improved Critical and similar abilities, but is calculated after all other modifiers. In addition, he cannot be disarmed while wielding a weapon from his chosen weapon group.

## Favored Class Bonuses

Instead of receiving an additional skill rank or hit point whenever he gains a level in a favored class, some races have the option of choosing from a number of other bonuses, depending upon his favored classes. The following options are available to the listed race who have warrior as his favored class, and unless otherwise stated, the bonus applies each time you select the listed favored class reward.

* **[Aegyl](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/base-races/aegyl/):** Add +1 to the warrior’s CMD when resisting a disarm or sunder attempt.
* **[Amalj’aa](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/beastman-tribes/amaljaa/):** Add +1 to the warrior’s CMD when resisting a disarm or sunder attempt.
* **[Antica](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/beastman-tribes/antica/):** Add +1 to the warrior’s CMD when resisting two combat maneuvers of the character’s choice.
* **[Au Ra](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/base-races/au-ra/):** Add +1 to CMD against bull rush or overrun maneuvers.
* **[Bangaa](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/base-races/bangaa/):** Add +1/2 to damage rolls the warrior makes with weapon attacks against an opponent he is flanking or an opponent that is denied its dexterity bonus to AC.
* **[Burmecian](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/races/base-races/burmecian/):** Add +1 to the warrior’s CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.

options.name: Adept: Formidable
options.description:

options.name: Adept: High Reflexes
options.description:

options.name: Adept: Lightning Speed
options.description:
The warrior applies his chosen weapon bonus to Initiative checks. If the warrior has the Quick Draw feat (or equivalent), he gains Quick Stow as a bonus feat, may draw weapons as part of making initiative checks, and may stow/sheathe a weapon as a free action.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Sacrifice Weapon
options.description:
When damage would cause the warrior or an adjacent ally to be knocked unconscious or killed, the warrior can redirect that damage to an equipped weapon, albeit the weapon's hardness is halved for damage calculation. Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Stable Footing
options.description:
When the warrior is wielding a weapon from his chosen weapon group, his chosen weapon bonus applies to his CMD against all combat maneuvers (instead of just Disarm/Sunder).
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Assuring Presence
options.description:
As a full-round action, the warrior grants all allies that are aware of him a +1 (insight) bonus on attack rolls, lasting until the end of the encounter. If the warrior is knocked unconscious or killed, this bonus is lost (until he is no longer unconscious or dead).
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Athlete
options.description:
The warrior gains a bonus to Acrobatics skill checks equal to half of his warrior level (rounded down). Additionally, he may choose to take 10 on any Acrobatics check, and may take 20 on them in half of the normal time.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Combat Feat
options.description:
A warrior may select any Combat feat instead of a talent. A warrior must still meet all prerequisites for this feat, including ability score and base attack bonus minimums. This talent may be selected multiple times choosing a new Combat feat each time.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Debilitating Assault
options.description:
The warrior uses his weapons' unique properties to cripple opponents. When an opponent takes physical damage from the warrior's chosen weapon, until their next turn, they suffer (non-stacking) penalties based on the damage type:  • Bludgeoning: -2 penalty to AC.  • Slashing: -2 penalty to hit.  • Piercing: -2 penalty to damage rolls.
Prerequisites: Warrior 4. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Decisive Disarm
options.description:
Once per encounter, when the warrior makes a Disarm check, he may add a +10 (untyped) bonus to it.
Prerequisites: Improved Disarm feat. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Effortless Dual-Wielding
options.description:
The warrior may treat one-handed weapons as light weapons for two-weapon fighting penalties.
Prerequisites: Warrior 6, Two-Weapon Fighting feat. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Extreme Effort
options.description:
A warrior that selects this talent may perform feats of extreme physical effort. When making a Strength check, the warrior doubles his strength bonus. At 11th level, triple the strength bonus, and at 16th level, quadruple the strength bonus. The warrior may always take 10 on any Strength checks.
Prerequisites: Strength 15. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Fast Movement
options.description:
A warrior that selects this talent increases his base speed by 10 ft.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Honed Agility
options.description:
When the warrior uses his Dexterity modifier as his hit bonus for attacks with a melee weapon, he may also use it for the damage roll, though he does not gain 1.5x when two-handing his weapons but still applies only 0.5x for off-hand weapons. When the warrior throws a weapon that would use his Strength modifier for damage rolls, he may also use it as his hit bonus. Additionally, the warrior may replace any instance of Strength within his abilities/talents with Dexterity (including [Overhand Chop](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/warrior/#warrior-techniques) and [Backswing](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/classes/core-classes/warrior/#additional-techs-iii), multipliers for 2-handing are reduced by 0.5x; 2x becomes 1.5x).

options.name: Martial Arts Training
options.description:

Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Melee Defense
options.description:

Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Melee Power
options.description:
A warrior with this talent adds +2 to damage with all weapons from his chosen weapon group.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Melee Tenacity
options.description:
A warrior with this talent may reroll 1s for damage with all weapon dice from his chosen weapon group.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Parry
options.description:
The warrior can negate a melee attack by rolling an opposed attack roll, DC = the opponent’s attack roll. This uses one of the warrior’s attacks of opportunity (if he has more with Combat Reflexes) for the round in which it is used. He receives a –5 penalty to his attack roll every time he uses this after the first. He must have a melee weapon in hand, and he must be aware of his foe and not flat-footed.
Prerequisites: Warrior 4, Melee Defense warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Rain of Blows
options.description:
The warrior may make an extra attack at his highest BAB with his chosen weapon as part of a full attack, but all of his attacks take a -2 penalty that turn. This does not stack with anything that could grant his main-hand weapon extra attacks (such as Haste), but he may gain other extra attacks (such as from two-weapon fighting).
Prerequisites: Warrior 6. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Riposte
options.description:
Once per encounter, after the warrior successfully uses Parry against an opponent, he may make a melee attack against them as an immediate action.
Prerequisites: Warrior 6, Melee Defense and Parry warrior talents. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Steel Headbutt
options.description:
While wearing medium or heavy armor, a warrior can deliver a headbutt with his helm as part of a full attack action. This headbutt is in addition to his normal attacks, and is made using the warrior’s base attack bonus – 5. A helmet headbutt deals 1d3 points of damage if the warrior is wearing medium armor, or 1d4 points of damage if he is wearing heavy armor (1d2 and 1d3, respectively, for Small creatures), plus an amount of damage equal to half the warrior’s Strength modifier. Treat this attack as a weapon attack made using the same special material (if any) as the armor. The armor’s enhancement bonus does not modify the headbutt attack, but the helm can be enchanted as a separate weapon.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Uncanny Dodge
options.description:
The warrior can react to danger before his senses would normally allow him to do so. He cannot be caught flat-footed, even if the attacker is invisible. He still loses his Dexterity bonus to AC if immobilized. A warrior with this ability can still lose his Dexterity bonus to AC if an opponent successfully uses the feint action against him. If a warrior already has uncanny dodge from a different class, he automatically gains improved uncanny dodge (see below) instead.
Prerequisites: Warrior 6. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Unhindered Movement
options.description:
The warrior counts his strength score as 4 higher for carrying capacity. The warrior ignores movement penalties of medium armor. He counts worn medium armor as medium or light, whichever is more beneficial (choosing which otherwise), for any sake. A warrior with 10 or more hit dice also ignores movement penalties of heavy armor and counts worn heavy armor as heavy or medium in the same way.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Warrior Spirit
options.description:
The warrior gains a 'Spirit Pool' with value equal to (1 + his chosen weapon bonus). While wielding a weapon from his chosen weapon group, as a swift action, he can spend 1 point from this pool to grant the weapon an enhancement bonus equal to his chosen weapon bonus. This bonus stacks with existing enhancement bonuses (up to +5), and the warrior may also use it to grant weapons special abilities (using their enhancement bonus cost). Weapons must have at least a +1 bonus to gain weapon special abilities (either from the weapon itself or granted by this ability). This ability lasts for 1 minute after use.
Prerequisites: Warrior 6. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Warrior’s Tactics
options.description:
All of the warrior’s allies are treated as if they had the same teamwork feats as the warrior for the purpose of determining whether the warrior receives a bonus from his teamwork feats. His allies do not receive any bonuses from these feats unless they actually have the feats themselves. The allies’ positioning and actions must still meet the prerequisites listed in the teamwork feat for the warrior to receive the listed bonus.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Warrior's Vigilance
options.description:
The warrior gains Endurance as a bonus feat. If he already has that feat, he may select another feat for which he meets the prerequisites which lists Endurance as a prerequisite. In addition, he may sleep in medium or heavy armor without becoming fatigued, he requires half as much sleep as normal, and can survive twice as long without food and water before needing to make checks. Finally, the penalty for Perception checks made while the warrior is sleeping is halved.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Weapon Aptitude
options.description:
The warrior can spend an hour in practice to change his chosen weapon group. He must have the newly designated weapon available during his practice session to make this change. For example, if he wishes to change his Chosen Weapon from heavy blades to light blades, he must have a light blade weapon available to practice with during his practice session.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adaptable Training
options.description:
The warrior gains 1 extra skill point per level in warrior. This talent may be selected four times.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Antimagic Tactics
options.description:
The warrior adds his chosen weapon bonus to the DC of concentration checks of enemies he threatens. This stacks with other increases (or penalties), such as from the Disruptive feat. This applies even if the warrior has no attacks of opportunity left, but not if he is unable to attack a foe due to other reasons.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Armed Maneuver
options.description:
The warrior chooses a combat maneuver - he adds his chosen weapon bonus to all checks for that maneuver. If the warrior attempts that maneuver without provoking, he adds his chosen weapon's enhancement bonus to the check. This talent may be taken multiple times to apply it to more maneuvers.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Critical Specialty
options.description:
When the warrior deals a critical hit with a weapon he has selected with the Weapon Focus feat or that belong to a weapon group he possesses, the save DCs of any effects caused by the critical hit increase by the warrior’s chosen weapon bonus.
Prerequisites: Weapon Focus feat or Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Weapon Focus feat or Chosen Weapon class feature

options.name: Adept: Flanking Leader
options.description:
When the warrior flanks a creature, he and fellow allies that flank it gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to half of his chosen weapon bonus (rounded down, minimum 1). If the warrior has the Gang Up feat, this effect instead applies to all allies that threaten it (even for only one ally). In addition, the warrior gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls against creatures he flanks.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Flash Feint
options.description:
The warrior gains Bluff as a class skill. He adds his chosen weapon bonus on Bluff checks to feint and to the DCs of feint checks made against him. If the warrior has the Improved Feint feat, he can feint as part of his first attack during a full attack. If the warrior has the Greater Feint feat, once per turn, he can attempt a feint as a swift action.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Graceful Blows
options.description:
When the warrior makes a melee attack with a weapon he is proficient with using his Dexterity modifier on the attack roll in the place of his Strength modifier (such as using Weapon Finesse) and uses his Strength modifier on the damage roll, he doubles his chosen weapon bonus on the damage roll.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Graceful Throw
options.description:
When the warrior makes a ranged attack with a thrown weapon he is proficient with and applies his Dexterity modifier on attack rolls and his Strength modifier on the damage roll, he doubles his chosen weapon bonus on the damage roll.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Retaliation Expert
options.description:
The warrior doubles his chosen weapon bonus to attack rolls for attacks of opportunity, and can make additional attacks of opportunity per round equal to half of his chosen weapon bonus (rounded down, minimum 1). If the warrior has the Stand Still feat, when he hits with an attack of opportunity, he may use Stand Still's combat maneuver check as part of that attack. The warrior also adds double his chosen weapon bonus on Stand Still's combat maneuver checks.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Sever Influence
options.description:
A number of times equal to his chosen weapon bonus, the warrior can use a swift action to allow an ally within his threat range to attempt a new saving throw against an ongoing mind-affecting effect. On a successful saving throw, the effect ends.
Prerequisites: Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Adept: Spell Parry
options.description:
As an immediate action, when the warrior makes an initial saving throw against a spell, spell-like ability or supernatural ability, he may add his chosen weapon bonus to the saving throw.
Prerequisites: Disruptive feat, Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Disruptive feat, Chosen Weapon class feature

options.name: Arsenal
options.description:
The warrior gains proficiency in all exotic melee weapons. In addition, the warrior may change his chosen weapon group as a full-round action.
Prerequisites: Weapon Aptitude warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Battle Commander
options.description:
The bonus granted by Assuring Presence is increased to +2, and Assuring Presence may be used as a standard or move action.
Prerequisites: Assuring Presence warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Decisive Strike
options.description:
Once per encounter, when the warrior makes an attack, he may add his warrior level to either the hit bonus or damage bonus. This is chosen before the attack is made. If the warrior has the Decisive Disarm talent, its bonus also increases to his warrior level.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Defensive Circle
options.description:
As a swift or move action, while Assuring Presence is active, the warrior enhances its effects to also apply its bonus to AC.
Prerequisites: Assuring Presence warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Devastating Melee Smash
options.description:
Once per encounter, before making the warrior’s attack roll, he may choose to add his warrior levels to damage with a melee weapon. If he misses, this attempt is wasted. This talent may be selected multiple times, each time granting one additional attempt per encounter.
Prerequisites: Melee Power warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Dreaded Warrior
options.description:
The warrior may use Dazzling Display as a move action. When combat begins, the warrior may use Dazzling Display as part of making his initiative roll - when he does, its range (for that use) expands to affect any foe aware of the warrior.
Prerequisites: Adept: Formidable warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Endless Battle
options.description:
Once per encounter, as a standard action, the warrior may gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice his warrior level plus his Constitution modifier. Once the encounter ends, if the warrior had leftover temporary hit points from this talent, he heals by that amount. He also heals the full amount if he didn't use the talent for that encounter. This talent only functions for encounters with actively hostile and threatening enemies.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Ferocity
options.description:
A warrior that selects this talent may continue fighting without penalty until his [hit points](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/combat#TOC-Hit-Points) (HP) reaches a negative of 10 + his Constitution score.
Prerequisites: Diehard feat. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Greater Penetrating Attack
options.description:
The warrior gains the Greater Penetrating Strike feat as a bonus feat.
Prerequisites: Warrior 16, Penetrating Attack warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Heroic Assault
options.description:
The warrior can choose to take cumulative –2 penalties on all attack rolls to increase their critical threat range by 1 per -2 penalty imposed, up to a maximum of a -10 penalty and increase by 5. This bonus is applied after doubling critical threat range (such as from Improved Critical or Keen), and after any other such bonuses.
Prerequisites: Improved Critical feat with chosen weapon. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Improved Critical feat with chosen weapon

options.name: Hustle
options.description:
Whenever the warrior would be allowed to take a ‘5 ft. step’ he may take a ‘10 ft. step’ instead. Any ability, effect, feat, or rule that applies to a ‘5 ft. step’ now applies when he takes a ‘10 ft. step’.
Prerequisites: Fast Movement warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Improved Fast Movement
options.description:
A warrior that selects this talent increases his base speed by 10 ft.
Prerequisites: Fast Movement warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
options.description:
The warrior can no longer be flanked. This defense denies a character the ability to sneak attack the warrior by flanking him, unless the attacker has at least four more levels than the target does. If a character already has uncanny dodge (see above) from another class, the levels from the classes that grant uncanny dodge stack to determine the minimum level required to flank the character.
Prerequisites: Uncanny Dodge class feature or warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Uncanny Dodge class feature or warrior talent

options.name: Indomitable
options.description:
This talent allows a warrior to add his Constitution modifier to his Will saving throws instead of his Wisdom.
Prerequisites: Warrior's Vigilance warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Item Mastery
options.description:
The warrior gains an item mastery feat as a bonus feat, which functions with any magic weapon he wields, even if the magic weapon does not meet the feat’s normal requirements. He must meet all of the feat’s prerequisites.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Knockout Training
options.description:
The warrior takes no penalties on attack rolls when attempting to deal nonlethal damage. The warrior may deal nonlethal damage even to enemies that are normally immune to it. He also bypasses any resistances/reductions that specifically apply to nonlethal damage (normal resistances are unaffected).
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Martial Arts Master
options.description:
The warrior treats his warrior level as his monk level for the Martial Arts Training talent. He always counts unarmed strikes as his chosen weapon.
Prerequisites: Martial Arts Training warrior talent, Chosen Weapon class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Martial Arts Training warrior talent, Chosen Weapon class feature

options.name: Mobile Attack
options.description:
Immediately after making a full attack where the warrior attacked with two light or one-handed weapons (or both ends of a double weapon), he may move up to his movement speed as a swift action.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Reinforced Fortitude
options.description:
If a warrior makes a Fortitude save that has an effect on a successful save, he takes no effect on a successful save (i.e., ‘‘Fortitude partial’ becomes ‘Fortitude negate'). This ability can only be used if the warrior is wearing light armor, medium armor, or no armor. A helpless warrior does not gain the benefit of the Reinforced Fortitude ability.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Reinforced Will
options.description:
If a warrior makes a Will save that has an effect on a successful save, he takes no effect on a successful save (i.e., ‘Will half' becomes ‘Will negate’). This ability can only be used if the warrior is wearing light armor, medium armor, or no armor. A helpless warrior does not gain the benefit of the Reinforced Will ability.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Penetrating Attack
options.description:
The warrior gains the Penetrating Strike feat as a bonus feat.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Reactionary
options.description:
This talent allows a warrior to add his Constitution modifier to his Reflex saving throws instead of his Dexterity.
Prerequisites: Warrior's Vigilance warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Riposte Mastery
options.description:
As per riposte, however, the warrior may make an additional riposte for each attack he has successfully parried, however, all ripostes after the first receive a –5 penalty to his attack roll for each time used after the first one.
Prerequisites: Warrior 14, Melee Defense, Parry, and Riposte warrior talents. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.
options.prerequisiteText: Warrior 14, Melee Defense, Parry, and Riposte warrior talents

options.name: Solid Frame
options.description:
The warrior may choose to be considered one size larger for the purpose of what combat maneuvers he can affect enemies with, and what maneuvers and special abilities enemies can affect him with. He does not take penalties for using weapons of inappropriate size. This talent does not affect weapon damage or the warrior's actual size.
Prerequisites: Unhindered Movement warrior talent, Strength 17. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Spell Smash
options.description:
The warrior can attempt to sunder an ongoing spell effect by succeeding at a combat maneuver check. For any effect other than one on a creature, the warrior must make a sunder combat maneuver check against a CMD of 15 plus the effect’s caster level. To sunder an effect on a creature, the warrior must succeed at the check listed above or a sunder combat maneuver against the creature’s CMD +5 if this is higher, ignoring any miss chance caused by a spell or spell-like ability. If successful, the warrior suppresses the effect for 1 round, or 2 rounds if she exceeded the CMD by 5 to 9. If he exceeds the CMD by 10 or more, the effect is dispelled. The warrior can only use this ability once per minute.
Prerequisites: Spellbreaker feat. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Streamlined Flexibility
options.description:
As part of using Martial Flexibility, the warrior may also choose up to two feats he qualifies for, thereafter counting himself as having those feats for the purposes of prerequisites of other feats chosen with Martial Flexibility. He does not gain the chosen feats' benefits. The warrior may swap these chosen feats for others as part of any usage of Martial Flexibility, and he is only considered to have them while Martial Flexibility is active.
Prerequisites: Martial Flexibility class feature. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Storm of Blows
options.description:
The warrior may make an additional extra attack when using Rain of Blows at the cost of making its penalty -4 instead of -2.
Prerequisites: Rain of Blows warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Supreme Armorer
options.description:
While wearing armor, the warrior adds one-quarter of his warrior level to its armor bonus, up to +5. This does not increase the armor's base bonus (for purposes of other abilities).
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Weapon Defense Flair
options.description:
While affected by the Melee Defense talent and not wielding a shield, the warrior counts as both wielding and not wielding a shield for any purpose, whichever is more beneficial (chosen by the warrior otherwise); he may likewise choose to count one of his wielded weapons as a shield, counting the Melee Defense AC bonus as its base AC bonus. He adds half of the total enhancement bonus of all of his wielded weapons (rounded down, maximum +5) as an enhancement bonus to his shield AC from Melee Defense. This talent counts as the Shield Focus feat. This talent does not allow the warrior to enchant weapons as shields. Using this talent disables Melee Defense from stacking with other shield AC bonuses.
Prerequisites: Melee Defense warrior talent. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Weapon Quality Expert
options.description:
At the start of each day, the warrior selects up to two specific weapons and one weapon quality from the list below. The warrior counts those wielded weapons as having the selected quality. The available qualities are:   • Ordinary Qualities: Brace, Disarm, Trip, Nonlethal.   • Light - This unique quality can only be applied to one-handed weapons. It allows the weapon to be considered as light for two-weapon fighting penalties and items and abilities/feats that affect light weapons.   • Mounted - This unique quality allows a weapon to be wielded in one hand and doubles its damage while the wielder is mounted. (It functions exactly as a Lance, and cannot be applied to a Lance.)   • Thrown - This unique quality grants the weapon a thrown range increment of 20ft. It also lets it function with items and abilities/feats that require thrown weapons.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Weapon Reach Flair
options.description:
All two-handed weapons the warrior wields are considered to have the reach quality. While the warrior wields a weapon with the reach quality (including from this talent), he also threatens and may attack targets in adjacent squares with it.
Prerequisites: —. Check any external feat, equipment, score and extra subchoice manually.

options.name: Bull Rush
options.description:

This choice is made at 1st level and can be changed to a different maneuver at each new warrior level.
Selected maneuver: Bull Rush. Later legal changes are recorded manually on this ability card.

At 1st level, the warrior trains to avoid the folly of what he would inflict on his opponents. He adds half his warrior level (minimum 1) to his CMD versus one of the following maneuvers: [Bull Rush](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Bull-Rush), [Dirty Trick](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Dirty-Trick), [Disarm](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Disarm), [Drag](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Drag), [Grapple](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Grapple), [Overrun](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Overrun), [Reposition](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Reposition), [Steal](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Steal), [Sunder](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Sunder), [Trip](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/Combat/#TOC-Trip).

This choice is made at 1st level and can be changed to a different maneuver at each new warrior level.
Selected maneuver: Sunder. Later legal changes are recorded manually on this ability card.

options.name: Improved Bull Rush
options.description:
At 2nd level, a warrior trains to always pull off the maneuver he has in mind. He gains a bonus feat from the “improved” feats for combat maneuvers, such as [Improved Bull Rush](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/feats/combat-feats/improved-bull-rush-combat), even if he does not have the normal prerequisites for that feat.

This choice is made at 2nd level, and can be changed to a different “improved” maneuver feat at each new warrior level. This cannot be changed if it is used as a pre-requisite for another feat.
